title: Haathi aur patli rassi
ig_caption: Tumhe duniya ne nahi, tumhari purani haar ne baandh rakha hai ⛓️🐘

haathi.look: a huge old grey Indian circus elephant with one chipped left tusk, a faded red-and-gold embroidered cloth on its back and sad amber eyes

baby_haathi.look: a small baby grey Indian elephant with big amber eyes and a tiny red-and-gold cloth on its back

mahavat.look: a thin middle-aged Indian circus mahout with a grey moustache, white turban and faded orange kurta

bachcha.look: a curious 8-year-old Indian village boy in a blue half-sleeve shirt and khaki shorts

narrator.look: a kind Indian storyteller in his 60s with a neat white beard, round brass glasses, saffron shawl over a cream kurta, sitting in a cosy lamp-lit study full of old books, holding an open leather storybook

shots.vo: सर्कस के एक विशाल हाथी को सिर्फ एक पतली सी रस्सी से बाँधा जाता था।
shots.cap: Circus ke ek vishaal haathi ko sirf ek patli si rassi se baandha jaata tha.
shots.image_prompt: Low-angle wide shot of the giant elephant standing calmly outside a striped circus tent at dusk, its massive front leg tied with only a thin frayed rope to a small wooden peg in the ground, lanterns glowing, dust in the air.
shots.motion_prompt: The elephant slowly swings its trunk, lantern flames flicker, dust drifts.

shots.vo: वो चाहता, तो एक झटके में पूरा खूँटा उखाड़ फेंकता।
shots.cap: Woh chahta, to ek jhatke mein poora khoonta ukhaad phenkta.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of the elephant's huge wrinkled leg and the thin rope tied around it, the tiny wooden peg barely in the soil, strong contrast between the giant leg and the weak rope.
shots.motion_prompt: The rope trembles slightly as the leg shifts its weight.

shots.vo: पर उसने कभी कोशिश ही नहीं की।
shots.cap: Par usne kabhi koshish hi nahi ki.
shots.image_prompt: Extreme close-up of the elephant's tired amber eye with long eyelashes and deep wrinkles, a tear of resignation, warm lantern light on the skin.

shots.vo: एक दिन एक बच्चे ने महावत से पूछा, ये भागता क्यों नहीं?
shots.cap: Ek din ek bachche ne mahaavat se poocha, ye bhaagta kyun nahi?
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot: the curious boy tugging the mahout's kurta and pointing at the tied elephant behind them, the mahout looking down at the boy, circus wagons in the background in golden afternoon light.
shots.motion_prompt: The boy points and looks up, the mahout turns his head.

shots.vo: महावत हँसा, और बोला... जब ये छोटा था, तब हमने इसे इसी रस्सी से बाँधा था।
shots.cap: Mahaavat hansa, aur bola... jab ye chhota tha, tab humne ise isi rassi se baandha tha.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of the mahout laughing knowingly, holding up the same thin frayed rope in his hand, warm side light, circus tent stripes blurred behind.
shots.motion_prompt: The mahout chuckles and lifts the rope slightly.

shots.vo: उस वक़्त इसने बहुत ज़ोर लगाया, रोया, तड़पा... पर रस्सी नहीं टूटी।
shots.cap: Us waqt isne bahut zor lagaaya, roya, tadpa... par rassi nahi tooti.
shots.image_prompt: Flashback: the baby elephant pulling desperately against a thin rope tied to a wooden peg, trunk raised crying, dust flying, dramatic stormy evening sky.
shots.motion_prompt: The baby elephant pulls and strains, the rope stretches tight, dust flies.

shots.vo: धीरे-धीरे, इसने मान लिया, कि ये रस्सी कभी नहीं टूटेगी।
shots.cap: Dheere-dheere, isne maan liya, ki ye rassi kabhi nahi tootegi.
shots.image_prompt: The baby elephant lying down exhausted on the dusty ground next to the peg, head resting on the soil, eyes half closed, the rope slack, cold blue moonlight.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow breathing, the baby elephant closes its eyes.

shots.vo: आज ये दस गुना ताक़तवर है, पर इसका दिमाग़ आज भी उसी रस्सी में बँधा है।
shots.cap: Aaj ye das guna taaqatwar hai, par iska dimaag aaj bhi usi rassi mein bandha hai.
shots.image_prompt: Symbolic shot: the giant adult elephant standing tall, and a ghostly thin rope wrapped around its forehead like a chain, faint image of the baby elephant reflected in a puddle below.
shots.motion_prompt: The ghostly rope glows faintly, ripples in the puddle.

shots.vo: फिर एक रात... सर्कस में आग लग गई।
shots.cap: Phir ek raat... circus mein aag lag gayi.
shots.image_prompt: Wide night shot of the circus tent on fire, huge orange flames and sparks against a dark sky, smoke rising, people running in silhouette.
shots.motion_prompt: Flames rage and sparks fly upward, smoke billows.

shots.image_prompt: Horses, camels and monkeys escaping through broken fences away from the burning circus, motion and panic, orange firelight on their bodies.
shots.motion_prompt: Animals run across the frame, embers fall.

shots.vo: पर वो हाथी वहीं खड़ा रहा... क्योंकि उसे लगता था, कि वो बँधा है।
shots.cap: Par woh haathi wahin khada raha... kyunki use lagta tha, ki woh bandha hai.
shots.image_prompt: The elephant standing still beside the thin rope and peg while fire burns behind it, its face lit by flames, eyes full of fear, the rope clearly loose on the ground.
shots.motion_prompt: Flames flicker behind, the elephant trembles but does not move.

shots.vo: इस कहानी से सीखो। तुम्हें दुनिया ने नहीं, तुम्हारी पुरानी हार ने बाँध रखा है।
shots.cap: Is kahaani se seekho. Tumhe duniya ne nahi, tumhari purani haar ne baandh rakha hai.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of a thin frayed rope snapping in the middle, fibres bursting apart in slow motion, glowing sunrise light behind it.
shots.motion_prompt: The rope snaps apart in slow motion, fibres float.

shots.vo: रस्सी कमज़ोर है। बस एक बार... फिर से ज़ोर लगाओ।
shots.cap: Rassi kamzor hai. Bas ek baar... phir se zor lagao.
shots.image_prompt: Hero shot from a low angle: the elephant walking free towards a golden sunrise over open hills, trunk raised triumphantly, the broken rope lying behind it.
shots.motion_prompt: The elephant walks forward and raises its trunk, birds fly.

shots.vo: वैसे सच बताना, आपकी वो कौन सी रस्सी है, जो आपको आगे बढ़ने से रोक रही है? कमेंट में लिखो, और ऐसी ही सीख के लिए, अभी फॉलो कर लो।
shots.cap: Vaise sach batana, aapki woh kaun si rassi hai, jo aapko aage badhne se rok rahi hai? Comment mein likho, aur aisi hi seekh ke liye, abhi follow kar lo.
shots.image_prompt: The storyteller looking warmly at the viewer and pointing with his index finger towards the camera, an open storybook on his lap, warm lamp light, bookshelves behind.
shots.motion_prompt: The storyteller smiles and points at the viewer, lamp light flickers.
